You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 24ae6b95be0836ecfdaff8f73c93f038b7db9569 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Piotr Rusin <piotr.rusin88@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Mar 2017 19:14:49 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] Rename the main package in test directory

This commit fixes a test initialization error introduced in the commit
179e7c and discovered just now. I missed the error before because I
hadn't written any tests at the moment, so I didn't feel like I had to
run the one test that was generated by Spring Tool Suite while
creating the project.

In the commit introducing the error, I renamed the main package of the
application from:

com.github.piotr.rusin.yule

to

com.github.piotr_rusin.yule,

but I forgot to do the same for its corresponding package in src/test
directory of the project.

As a result, no application configuration could be found, both for the
generated tests and for those introduced by me.

diff --git a/src/test/java/com/github/piotr/rusin/yule/YuleApplicationTests.java b/src/test/java/com/github/piotr_rusin/yule/YuleApplicationTests.java
similarity index 97%
rename from src/test/java/com/github/piotr/rusin/yule/YuleApplicationTests.java
rename to src/test/java/com/github/piotr_rusin/yule/YuleApplicationTests.java
index 6cc5d0d..dc0e64b 100644
--- a/src/test/java/com/github/piotr/rusin/yule/YuleApplicationTests.java
+++ b/src/test/java/com/github/piotr_rusin/yule/YuleApplicationTests.java
@@ -21,7 +21,7 @@
  * OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
  * SOFTWARE.
  *******************************************************************************/
-package com.github.piotr.rusin.yule;
+package com.github.piotr_rusin.yule;
 
 import org.junit.Test;
 import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `YuleApplicationTests.java`**
   - The package declaration was changed from `package com.github.piotr.rusin.yule;` to `package com.github.piotr_rusin.yule;`. This change aligns the test package with the renamed main application package.

### Relationships

- The modification in `YuleApplicationTests.java` is directly related to a previous change made in the main application package, where the package name was altered from `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule` to `com.github.piotr_rusin.yule`. This patch ensures that the test directory reflects the same package structure, thereby resolving the test initialization error caused by the inconsistency in package naming.

2. explain how the bug is fixed, including code statements fixing the bug and why.

Code statements included in point 1 should be as brief as possible, only include the ones that are most related to the root cause and  the number of code statements may not exceed 3.


Here is the commit message:
Rename the main package in test directory

This commit fixes a test initialization error introduced in the commit
179e7c and discovered just now. I missed the error before because I
hadn't written any tests at the moment, so I didn't feel like I had to
run the one test that was generated by Spring Tool Suite while
creating the project.

In the commit introducing the error, I renamed the main package of the
application from:

com.github.piotr.rusin.yule

to

com.github.piotr_rusin.yule,

but I forgot to do the same for its corresponding package in src/test
directory of the project.

As a result, no application configuration could be found, both for the
generated tests and for those introduced by me.

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by a mismatch in the package naming between the main application and the test directory. The main application package was renamed, but the corresponding test package was not updated, leading to application configuration not being found during test execution.

Here is the patch:

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```java
package com.github.piotr.rusin.yule; // Main application package
```
```java
package com.github.piotr_rusin.yule; // Test package (not updated)
```
Reason:
The mismatch between the main application package and the test package caused the application configuration to be unresolvable during test execution, as the test framework could not locate the necessary application context.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
package com.github.piotr_rusin.yule; // Updated test package
```
Reason:
By renaming the test package to match the new main application package, the application configuration can now be found during test execution, resolving the initialization error.
